descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S05 「现成 spec：AI 调用种类 × 失败——每个失败都看得见、提供重试、保留已输入的内容」 Existing specs: AI call kind × failure — each failure is visible, offers a retry and keeps what was entered

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up …（UAT OAT-03 step 3；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed)；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94422 AC 5；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style（TFA-94745 AC 5；TFA-94745 AC 1）
  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; …（UAT OAT-03 step 1；UAT OAT-03 step 2；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT 3.5；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-92568 AC 5）

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Tim's chromium fixtures; one AI action per test fails at the Convex socket

When Pre-round summary (Save Note), billing suggestion, pasted prior-note extraction, Save & Extract medication / task extraction, the course refresh after Generate (both contexts)

Then Summary: note text kept, error and a visible retry. Billing: note still shown, 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry', the code appears on tap. Prior note: note text kept, retry from the UI. Save & Extract: the half that succeeded is kept when the other fails. Course refresh: today's line still finished in Hospital and Nursing Home

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions. Summary and billing are Hospital only. Nursing Home pre-round summary, Ask AI and handoff have no failure spec: S06 forces them; no Nursing Home billing failure spec exists (recorded). These inject a client-side failure, so they show the failure state, not the server's automatic retry (S03)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
